about: Auto Answer decider: ModernBERT-base (149.6M) student v5 = uniform soup of 3 seeds fine-tuned from student yt2 (lr 1e-5, 2 epochs, alpha 0.7) on dataset-v5 (real shared meetings + 78 public YouTube calls, Claude Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.2 + GPT 6.1 Sol labels, likely label errors re-voted) with an equal replay of yt2's synthetic rows. Thresholds fitted on the cleaned calib split (two strong labellers per moment): answer 0.815, silent 0.765, wait 0.855. Paid, private download: int8 per-channel reduced range on onnxruntime 1.24.3 (Windows, Apple Silicon macOS 14+), 4-bit MatMulNBits on 1.22 (Intel Macs, macOS 13). Gold (int8, app pipeline): 136/187 decided alone, 0 false answers. ml/auto-answer-decider.
